_README: Copy to config/usage-limits.json (private, gitignored). MOST OF THE DASHBOARD NEEDS NOTHING HERE: Claude Code token usage is measured from your local transcripts, and Cowork's REAL $ is measured from its local audit.jsonl — both work out of the box. This file only supplies (a) 'operator' = the name shown in the header, (b) 'window' = the default reporting period, and (c) OPTIONAL 'usage_limit.limit/resets' labels used ONLY when you fetch real spend with -Cloud (needs ANALYTICS_API_KEY). No $ is invented from these values.
_note_usage_limit: Only used when a REAL spent is fetched via -Cloud (Analytics API). Without that fetch the whole block is NOT rendered — the dashboard never shows a stale hand-typed $ as if it were current.
_note_token_limit: 0 = OFF, and OFF is correct. There is no official Anthropic token quota, and deriving a $-per-token rate from a made-up token_limit produced numbers that measured data contradicted by ~21x — so all estimated-$ output was removed. Only set this if you have a REAL, measured figure.
